captions.detailed: A wall-mounted box fan featuring a dark grey, square main housing with an open back protected by a grid. Inside the housing is a central hub with five dark fan blades, and a light grey wall-mounting bracket is attached to the rear. The housing is designed to pan left and right on a vertical joint at the wall bracket, while the fan blades and a front-mounted speed control knob are capable of continuous rotational movement.
captions.instruction: Generate a wall-mounted square box fan as an articulated 3D model. The assembly should include a rear wall bracket, a main square housing with a protective grid, a five-blade interior propeller, and a small front-facing control knob. Define rotational joints allowing the housing to pan relative to the wall bracket, the propeller to spin continuously, and the knob to rotate.
captions.factory: Construct the wall bracket using a flat rectangular plate (Box) combined with a short horizontal support block. Build the main housing as a hollowed square frame with an integrated rear wire grid composed of thin intersecting cylinders. Model the propeller with a central cylindrical hub and five extruded fan blades patterned radially. Create the control knob as a small cylinder positioned near a corner of the housing. Finally, establish four parts (bracket, housing, propeller, knob) and link them with three joint articulations: a revolute joint for the housing pan, and continuous rotational joints for the propeller spin and knob rotation.
